dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: You do know you were invited to the Akademiya party, right? You're really not gonna show your face?

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Heh, I don't remember doing anything worth getting invited. It's just another noisy room of people... Not my scene.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Look, I'm no scholar, but even I've heard about your work in historical criticism and modern political research.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: You provided the clues and inspiration for their big paper. That basically makes you their hero. Your contribution is half the reason they even have something to celebrate.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: You'd think someone from the "Temple of Silence" would know when to stop talking...

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Okay, okay, I can take a hint. I'm just letting you know, they're gonna drag you there one way or another.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Hah, believe it or not, I do know when to keep my mouth shut. But, since I know you pretty well, they did ask me to come find you.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: For the love of... Fine. Show me the way.
